reason: This plugin’s primary purpose is to let users switch conversation agent presets during an active DeepSeek session via a header UI control, which changes orchestration behavior for subsequent turns. Evidence in the readme shows both client-side UI replacement and server-side route handling for preset changes, with a turn-state guard and session event logging as implemented safeguards.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面中新增会话头部模式切换器，支持在会话进行中切换 Standard / Code / Minimal / Creator 等对话模式。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a session-header mode switcher in DeepSeek Harness so users can change agent presets mid-conversation, including Standard, Code, Minimal, Creator, and custom presets.

capabilities: injects a conversation-header action to switch the active agent preset
registers a host route to update session agent preset state
validates and blocks preset switching while a turn is running
records preset-switch events into the session log
supports custom presets defined in the host

reasons.code: README states the plugin replaces the built-in read-only session header agent preset label with a selectable menu and sends a sessionId/agentPreset payload to the host route.
README explains the host registers POST /change-convo-mode/switch and applies changes via host agent preset recompose logic, then logs an agent-preset/selected event.
package.json declares a web plugin bundle and client injection for UI/runtime modules, indicating runtime behavior is tied to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and session actions.
